sender.en: A recruiter or “HR” on WhatsApp, Instagram or Telegram

name.en: Part-time task job: “earn ₹5,000 a day liking videos or writing reviews”

how.en: A WhatsApp or Instagram message offers part-time work from home: like YouTube videos, follow pages or write Google reviews for hotels and restaurants for a few hundred rupees each. You get small payments first and are added to a Telegram group. Then come “prepaid” or “VIP” tasks where you must deposit money to earn a bigger commission; the balance on a website grows but can never be withdrawn without paying more fees. Real jobs never ask you to pay to work.

text.en: An unknown number offers easy part-time money for likes or reviews.
You are paid a little at first, then moved to a Telegram group.
“Prepaid” tasks need you to deposit money by UPI.
To withdraw your earnings you are told to pay a tax, upgrade or penalty first.

Hi, I am Riya from a digital marketing agency. We need part-time staff to give 5-star Google reviews for hotels. ₹150 per review, earn ₹3,000-₹8,000 daily from home. Interested? Reply YES and I will add you to our Telegram task group.

Money for likes, follows, ratings or reviews.
Being moved from WhatsApp to Telegram.
Paying in to “unlock” tasks or withdraw.
Don't send any money; block the number and leave the group.
If you paid, call 1930 at once and report on cybercrime.gov.in.
Report the WhatsApp number on Chakshu.
